job_description: Position Type:  10 months initially (daily rate basis consultant) Duration:  January to October 2027 Reports to:  E-Governance Coordinator Location:  Dhaka (Office of the Registrar General-ORG) Project Background The project "E-ffective Governance: Accelerating e-government and digital public services in Bangladesh" aims to enhance transparency, accountability, and responsiveness in public service delivery through improved e-government tools and processes. Implemented by the e-Governance Academy (eGA) and the British Council, the project addresses three main objectives: Improving digital interaction, coordination, and communication between government ministries, agencies, and departments (G2G). Strengthening the capacities of public sector employees for better performance and service delivery (G2E). Improving the quality of public services for citizens by ensuring efficient service delivery (G2C). The project targets multiple groups, including government entities, public employees, civil society organisations (CSOs), and private enterprises. This initiative aims to address challenges like fragmented e-services, infrastructure gaps, and inefficiencies in public service delivery. Purpose of this position The purpose of the position is to provide specialised system engineering support to the Office of the Registrar General (ORG) to strengthen the architecture, security, performance, interoperability and long-term sustainability of the Birth and Death Registration Information System (BDRIS). The Consultant will also build the technical capacity of ORG ICT personnel through knowledge transfer and hands-on mentoring and will support ORG's readiness for secure data exchange with other agencies in the interest of smoother birth and death registration. The British Council is seeking a highly motivated and experienced System Engineer to support the Office of the Registrar General (ORG) in undertaking the responsibilities outlined below. The consultant will be contracted on a daily-rate basis and will provide services for up to 220 working days during the contract period. Accountabilities, Responsibilities, and Main Duties The scope includes but not limited to the followings: Develop and implement strategies for improving or further leveraging these systems. Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations related to network security. Provide technical support to resolve complex network issues. Ensure compatibility and interoperability of in-house computing systems such as: iLO and virtualization using VMware (vCenter, vRealize, NSX-T) Linux and Windows environments Microsoft Azure F5 (WAF, Load Balancer, DNS Security, SSL Offloader) and Nginx Plus Network monitoring and scalability Micro-segmentation in application security Router, firewall and switch configuration Apache Tomcat and IIS server configuration Active Directory, Exchange Server and mail server Monitor and test system performance; prepare and deliver system performance statistics and reports. Manage and monitor all installed systems and infrastructure. Install, configure, test and maintain operating systems, application software and system management tools. Proactively ensure the highest levels of systems and infrastructure availability. Develop and maintain the network architecture, including LAN, WAN, and Data Centre networks. Design scalable and resilient network solutions to meet business requirements. Implement and maintain network documentation and diagrams. Deploy, configure, and manage network hardware and software components such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and wireless infrastructure. Ensure proper network segmentation and security measures are in place. Collaborate with vendors and service providers to procure and implement network solutions. Implement network monitoring tools and processes to proactively identify and address performance issues. Analyze network traffic patterns and optimize network performance for maximum efficiency. Troubleshoot and resolve network-related incidents and outages promptly. Implement and enforce network security policies and best practices.

job_description: Machine Setup, Calibration & Optimization Configure and calibrate circular knitting machines for specific fabric constructions (e.g., Single Jersey, Interlock, Polar Fleece, Eyelet) by setting stitch length, yarn tension, cam boxes, needle/sinker arrangements, and machine RPM. Align dial and cylinder timing, positive yarn feeders, and take-down tension rollers during style or gauge changeovers to prevent horizontal barré, spirality, and GSM deviations. Fine-tune machine parameters in coordination with Process Engineers to maximize speed and yield without compromising fabric dimensional stability. Preventive & Routine Maintenance Execute scheduled preventive maintenance across mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and automatic lubrication systems in accordance with the section SOP. Inspect, clean, and replace wear-prone knitting elements—including needles, sinkers, cams, yarn feeders, and drive belts—to prevent premature component failure. Clean lint, filament dust, and oil buildup from needle beds, creels, and creel tubes using compressed air and manufacturer-recommended lubricants to prevent overheating and friction wear. Breakdown Troubleshooting & Electrical Diagnostics Diagnose and resolve real-time mechanical and electrical faults, including needle jams, broken sinkers, cam misalignments, motor/inverter faults, and faulty yarn-break/tension sensors. Conduct electrical circuit and control panel inspections using multimeters and diagnostic tools, replacing damaged wiring, switches, or sensors promptly to minimize machine downtime. Perform test runs at low speeds following major repairs or needle-bed overhauls to verify smooth rotation and eliminate abnormal noise or vibration before resuming bulk production. Inline Quality Control & Defect Prevention Conduct periodic inline fabric inspections alongside operators and QC staff to detect machine-induced defects such as vertical lines, needle streaks, dropped stitches, holes, and uneven loop formation. Adjust tensioners, stitch cams, or feeder settings immediately upon identifying quality deviations, supporting root-cause analysis (RCA) for recurring fabric defects. Safety, Compliance & 6S Housekeeping Enforce strict Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and power-isolation protocols prior to performing any mechanical or electrical servicing. Maintain full compliance with workplace health, safety, and buyer audit standards, ensuring safety guards, cam box covers, and roller locks remain secure during operation. Wear mandatory Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)—including safety glasses, cut-resistant gloves, and non-slip footwear—and maintain 5S/6S cleanliness standards around workstations. Operator Support, Documentation & Inventory Control Provide hands-on technical guidance and on-the-job training to Knitting Operators on basic machine handling, threading paths, and early fault detection. Maintain accurate digital/logbook records of daily machine servicing, breakdown root causes, calibration changes, and spare parts consumption. Track critical spare parts and consumables (needles, sinkers, belts, sensors) and notify the Sr. Technician in advance to prevent stockouts. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Machine Availability / Uptime: Maintain machine utilization and keep unplanned mechanical/electrical downtime at per machine. Machine Efficiency: Support floor operations in achieving daily machine running efficiency. Machine-Induced Defect Rate: Keep fabric rejection/rework caused by needle, sinker, or setting errors below . Preventive Maintenance Compliance: Achieve on-time completion of scheduled preventive maintenance and lubrication checklists. Needle & Spare Consumption Variance: Maintain needle and sinker breakage rates within standard budgeted norms per ton of polyester fabric produced.
